# ScriptBlock

*Common*

A block state: a block with its properties (rotation, open or closed and so on), from `c.getWorld().getBlock(x, y, z)`

or `scram.block(id)`. Changing it does not change the world; place it with `setBlock`.

```js
c.send(scram.block("minecraft:dirt").getName());
```

## Methods

### getMinecraftBlockState {#getminecraftblockstate}

::: member

**Returns** `BlockState` — the Minecraft block state, for Java code

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

```js
var block = c.getWorld().getBlock(0, 64, 0);

c.send("Block: " + block.getId());
```

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — block ID, like `"minecraft:stone"`; the state's properties are not included

:::

### isSame {#issame}

::: member

Checks whether both states are of the same block, ignoring their properties, e.g. two rotations of the same stairs.

```js
var world = c.getWorld();

if (world.getBlock(0, 64, 0).isSame(world.getBlock(0, 65, 0))) {
    c.send("Both blocks are of the same kind");
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) | other block state, not null |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether both are the same block

:::

### isOpaque {#isopaque}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the block fully blocks light

:::

### isAir {#isair}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the block is air (also cave air and void air)

:::

### isBurnable {#isburnable}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether fire can burn the block away

:::

### hasCollision {#hascollision}

::: member

Checks whether this block state's physical collision shape is nonempty at the specified position.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `world` | [`ScriptServerWorld`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerWorld) | world supplying neighboring blocks and block entities |
| `x` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block x |
| `y` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block y |
| `z` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | block z |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true for a nonempty collision shape; false for air and other non-colliding states

:::

### getProperties {#getproperties}

::: member

```js
var block = c.getWorld().getBlock(0, 64, 0);

for (var name of block.getProperties()) {
    c.send(name + " = " + block.getProperty(name));
}
```

**Returns** `List<String>` — new list with the names of the state's properties, like `"facing"` or `"open"`; empty for blocks without them

:::

### getName {#getname}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — name of the block in the game language, like `"Stone"`

:::

### getBlastResistance {#getblastresistance}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — how well the block resists explosions; stone has 6, obsidian 1200

:::

### getSlipperiness {#getslipperiness}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — how slippery the block is: 0.6 for most blocks, 0.98 for ice; higher values make entities slide more

:::

### getHardness {#gethardness}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — how long the block takes to break: stone has 1.5, -1 means unbreakable like bedrock

:::

### getVelocityMultiplier {#getvelocitymultiplier}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — factor of the speed of entities walking on the block; 1 for most blocks, lower for soul sand and honey

:::

### getJumpVelocityMultiplier {#getjumpvelocitymultiplier}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — factor of the jump height from the block; 1 for most blocks, lower for honey

:::

### getProperty {#getproperty}

::: member

Reads a property of the state.

```js
var door = c.getWorld().getBlock(0, 64, 0);

if (door.getId() == "minecraft:oak_door") {
    c.send("Door is open: " + door.getProperty("open"));
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | property name in any case, like `"open"` |

**Returns** `Any` — the value: a boolean, a number, or a Java enum for named values like `"facing"`

:::

### setProperty {#setproperty}

::: member

Sets the value of a specific block state property. Changes only this object; pass it to `setBlock` to apply it to the world. Values are parsed like in the `/setblock` command: booleans, whole numbers and names such as

`"north"` or `"upper"`; strings like `"true"` or `"3"` also work.

```js
var blockState = c.getWorld().getBlock(x, y, z);

if (blockState.getId() == "minecraft:oak_door") {
    blockState.setProperty("open", true);
    blockState.setProperty("facing", "north");
    c.getWorld().setBlock(blockState, x, y, z);
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | property name, case-insensitive. |
| `value` | `Any` | new value; see above for accepted forms. |

:::
